name: @aibranch/llm-meta-widget
//version: Must stay in step with lib/llm_meta_widget/version.rb. Two independently versioned copies of the same client is the drift docs/custom-element-distribution.md warns about: bump both, release both.
description: Embeddable browser chat widget: a custom element that discovers tools at page, origin and hub scope and dispatches each tool call to the right one. Two lines of HTML on any host, Rails or not.
author: Jin-Dong Kim
//packaging: Why main/exports/sideEffects/files are set this way: docs/custom-element-distribution.md, 'Publishing to npm'.

scripts.test: npm run test:js && npm run test:rb
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run test:js && npm run lint

//prepublishOnly: Deliberately test:js and not test:rb — publishing may run on a CI runner with no Ruby, and a release must not fail on a missing interpreter. The Ruby side is covered by `npm test` locally and by the gem's own release path.
